nc.description: A grey knob on a central post secures two white rectangular bars within grey brackets at a corner joint.
A light gray mechanical assembly features a cylindrical rod entering a housing that contains a circular disc and a rectangular block situated on a linear track.
A 3D rendering shows a mechanical assembly consisting of an inner toothed gear surrounded by spherical balls within an outer polygonal ring.
A stylized grey mechanical hand presses its thumb down onto a small, glowing, cracked cube resting on a curved base, with two large rings in the background.
Light grey geometric shapes are arranged in a symmetrical, radial pattern around a slightly illuminated central cluster on a white surface.

vc.description: Two grey mechanical clamps are holding three white cylindrical tubes between their textured jaws.
A monochromatic 3D rendering depicts a mechanical differential gear assembly with interlocking internal gears and extending shafts.
A cutaway view shows a static mechanical assembly containing a shaft with ball bearings located above a series of gears within a light-colored casing.
A close-up shows a gray, sculpted model featuring horizontal rods attached to a central block that connects to a vertical, threaded cylinder.
Various grey mechanical parts are arranged in a radiating circular pattern around a central cluster of white jointed components.
